title: Cosmic Particle Abyss
description: An abstract composition of thousands of overlapping luminous circles in vibrant rainbow hues fills the frame against a deep black background. Two large irregular dark voids dominate the upper portion, appearing like holes or negative spaces revealing a textured, shadowy core with hints of gold and teal within.
prompt: Abstract digital painting featuring thousands of overlapping soft glowing circles and particles in vibrant rainbow colors including turquoise, orange, yellow, teal and purple, scattered densely across the frame with two large irregular black voids in the upper half revealing dark textured centers with subtle golden and teal accents, bokeh-like light orbs, mysterious cosmic atmosphere, high contrast between bright colors and deep black background
